5. Deviations and design disclosure. Diagnosis outcome (a): ensureHostRoot (governance-scope.mjs) hardens the host-store directory to an owner-only inheriting DACL via hardenWindowsPrivateDirectory, the witness created inside inherits it, and privatePath() requires assessWindowsPrivatePath(...).status === 'secure' on win32; governance-scope-win32-acl.test.mjs asserts exactly that mechanism. Neither briefed option fit: applyDecision's return carries no privacy field, and no witness exists at module load to probe. Chosen: freshRepo records the witness path on win32 and ONE root after() hook calls assessWindowsPrivatePaths (one fixed PowerShell process per 64 paths, same owner/DACL/reparse policy) with timeout: 120000 passed explicitly (the default is 7000 ms). It is a hook, not a test case, so the case count is unchanged (63 on WSL). A privacy failure surfaces as a root-hook failure naming the witness path and status, NOT as a per-case red; a non-secure or unavailable result fails, and there is no t.skip. Outcome: the record uses committed-pending-report as the terminal value, as field 6 pins, rather than overwriting with 'completed', because independent review is pending. resultSha256 is null (authored-commit kind). Counting disclosure: 50 witnesses were recorded against the briefing's 51 baseline reds, so at least one baseline red probably had a different first cause that the :174 assertion masked (plausibly the symlink roundtrip); not investigated, so I cannot confirm from the baseline that the EPERM red is pre-existing. Wasted calls: two directory-scoped Glob/Grep calls were refused with GUARD-READ-TARGET before the first write; the first write was refused with GUARD-BOOTSTRAP-RECEIPT-MISSING and cured by running the preflight alone from the plugin root path the guard printed.

(a) Three signed-GMW cases ('matching signed GMW permits a non-kernel TP rewrite', 'wrong-scope signed GMW does not permit a TP rewrite', 'matching signed GMW never permits hooks.json kernel rewrite') fail with PB-WINDOWS-ASSURANCE thrown by ensureHardenedPrivateDirectory via applyInstall (pre-commit-hook-install.mjs:932): 'private path DACL grants a non-owner principal. The directory already existed and was left untouched.' Hypothesis, unverified: every other installHook case passes, and these three differ by the guard-maintenance-window setup before install, so that path may create the private agent-pipeline directory without win32 hardening; the dispatcher should check that in a separate dispatch (production is out of this briefing's scope). (b) 'applyInstall then applyRemoval: removes exactly what was installed' fails with EPERM on symlinkSync in the test (the Windows symlink privilege is missing on this host); a host limitation of the fixture, not a privacy defect. Independent review: pending. Native acceptance still needs those four resolved in follow-up dispatches.
